name: Mariana di Girolamo
bio: Mariana di Girolamo Arteaga is a Chilean film, theatre and television actress. She is known for Ema (2019), La Verónica (2020) and Kill The Jockey (2024).

credits.title: Wild Horse Nine
credits.overview: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. credits.title: Kill the Jockey
credits.overview: Remo's self-destructive behavior overshadows his talent. Abril, an upcoming jockey, is pregnant with Remo's baby and has to decide between the child or continuing to race. They both race for Sirena, a businessman who saved Remo's life in the past but now is determined to find him, dead or alive.

credits.title: AliEN0089
credits.overview: While a gamer uploads a testimonial video to denounce the harassment she suffers in a video game, a stranger enters her home and hacks her computer, blurring the boundaries between the real and virtual worlds.

credits.title: Electrophilia
credits.overview: A girl wakes up from a coma six weeks after being struck by lightning.

credits.title: La Verónica

credits.title: Ema
credits.overview: Ema is a magnetic and impulsive dancer in a reggaeton troupe. Her toxic marriage to choreographer Gastón is beyond repair, following a decision to give up on their adopted child Polo. She sets out on a mission to get him back, not caring who she’ll need to fight, seduce or destroy to make it happen.

credits.title: I Don’t Want to Be Your Brother
credits.overview: A 34-year-old man asks his girlfriend for marriage the same day that his sister Constanza arrives at his house, which will test his great differences.

credits.title: Young Times
credits.overview: Lucas and Socias are two best friends trying to grow up in a world that's moving against them, making them question the traditional belief that "youth is the best time of our lives".

credits.title: Hotel Zentai
credits.overview: Four stories intersect in a zentai meeting hotel, the sexual discipline, and fetish whose practitioners wear lycra suits and rub each other. Mother and daughter recognize each other in a ritual, a man does not decide what to wear, a coach loses his authority and two lovers never see their faces.

credits.title: Constitución
credits.overview: A photographer suffer from memory loss after a car accident and starts to hallucinate after taking the medicament that were supposed to help his condition.

credits.title: Much Ado About Nothing
credits.overview: After a night of partying, Vicente is involved in a hit-and-run that kills a man. Vicente claims his innocence, but he was drunk and high. A tangled web of lies buries the truth, making a social scandal disappear — exonerating the real culprit, the son of a powerful politician.
